The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a clear need for a large sample of benchmark objects in the T spectral type range to better constrain the mass-temperature relationship and to test atmospheric and evolutionary models at the low-mass, high-temperature end of the brown dwarf mass-temperature relationship.
the benchmark T dwarf population is still very small and more examples are needed to fully understand the properties of these interesting brown dwarfs and their formation mechanisms.
